package_subject: fix: bind console encoding, receipts, and export rebuilds
subagents_reason: The order forbids delegation. This process made the product edits itself.

tests.not_rerun: No full-suite run. Only ruff on the touched files and tests/test_windows_parity_20261106.py.

package.kind: deterministic stored source zip plus the unchanged provenance bytes
package.note: This result file is a later commit and is not a zip member. Rebuilding at the result commit changes the provenance commit and the hash. The pinned zip is the clean build at 57de232.

decode_console_bytes.encoding: Optional codec name. Use cp850, cp1252, or utf-8 for the console's actual OutputEncoding. Only that codec is decoded. There is no fallback to another page.
decode_console_bytes.omitted_encoding: UTF-8 is accepted only when the bytes are strict UTF-8. Legacy pages are accepted only when every page that round-trips yields the same text. cp850 and cp1252 of Größe disagree, so the result is ambiguous and is not a text success.

api.console_plan: console_plan(..., output_encoding='cp1252') inserts --encoding before the command
api.handoff_field: WindowsConsoleHandoffInput.output_encoding, optional, for example cp850, cp1252, or utf-8
api.completion_rule: state completed requires type(exit_code) is int, both streams decoded_strict true, and stdout/stderr sha256 plus byte_length equal to text.encode(encoding). A bool exit code, a missing field, or a hash that does not match the text stays open. An open or invalid receipt is not started again.

do_not: Do not omit encoding when the guest has both an OEM and an ANSI page. That case stays open on purpose.
Do not treat decoded_strict false or state open as a successful Größe text.
Do not rebuild with an invented commit, a dirty flag flipped to false, or a changed provenance file.
Do not test the old RC31 installation. Use the new staging install.
codex_driver.default_write: In the same normal console, read [Console]::OutputEncoding.CodePage and pass encoding='cp' plus that number to decode_console_bytes, or output_encoding on the handoff, then run [Console]::Write('Größe').
codex_driver.explicit_1252: Set [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(1252) in that console and pass encoding='cp1252'. The expected text is Größe, decoded_strict true, encoding cp1252.
codex_driver.cp850_case: When the code page is 850, pass encoding='cp850'. The expected text is Größe, decoded_strict true, encoding cp850.
codex_driver.ambiguous_case: decode_console_bytes(bytes, legacy=('cp850','cp1252')) without encoding must return text '', ambiguous true, decoded_strict false, and raw_base64 of the original bytes. cp1252 bytes must not come back as Gr÷▀e with cp850 and decoded_strict true.
codex_driver.receipt_case: A result with stdout altered, sha256 of 64 zeroes, encoding utf-8, and no int exit_code must not reconcile as completed and must not start a new process.
codex_driver.guest_build: From the extracted tree, with the validated provenance.json left byte-for-byte unchanged: python -B scripts/windows_parity_package.py build --output dist\KiraBridge-0.8.0rc40-windows-parity-20261106.zip --provenance-export provenance.json
